_doc: Raid-hound (act1/raid_hound.md): coat (mud-coloured; vertex colour, cavity and wetness carry the saddle, the brindle, the pale underparts and the flats' mud), leather (the Y-harness and the headstall, oiled tortoiseshell), lacquer (the red-lacquered muzzle cage and the Order's plate at the withers; clearcoated through vertex wetness, which does not darken it), metal (the brass rings and buckles), eye. The coat's emission mask is the one small closed spawn_wound mark, the old gaff scar on its breast (the weak point, ADR 0151; M3-CRE-650). M3-CRE-655 added the lacquer and metal slots. write_materials.py on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader.
